_help_1: Recording plan for the authorized staged footage. Single source of truth shared by data/footage_shotlist.md and data/tools/prepare_session_manifest.py.
_help_2: Split assignment is FROZEN here BEFORE recording and before anyone sees a system result (SS21.5). A scenario_id never appears under two splits.
_help_3: This file is a PLAN, not a manifest. It carries no hashes and no consent claims. Sealed manifests are produced by prepare_session_manifest.py into data/manifests/.

cameras.cam_01: Wide view of a corridor or lobby including a doorway/entrance.
cameras.cam_02: Wide open area, three people fit with room to cross paths; one pillar or column available to occlude behind.

sessions.staged_scenario_description: Gate G1 anchor: one uninterrupted 60-minute fixed-camera recording. Contains a repeated black-backpack event with four occurrences, a cross-window entrance followed ~10 minutes later by an exit carrying the backpack, four genuinely empty intervals, and an in-context blue-bag wrong-attribute decoy.
Development counterpart to the G1 hour so long-scope thresholds can be tuned without touching the test split. Entrance with no object, later exit carrying a black suitcase, plus two empty intervals.

Colour-attribute core. Black-backpack positive, an identical action with the matched blue backpack (wrong-attribute decoy), the same action with a black suitcase (wrong-object decoy), and a visually similar actor pair.

Binding: which person carries which object. Correct binding, wrong-person binding, wrong-object binding, a three-way scene, and a handoff where two people each satisfy the description at different times.
Temporal order and partial events. Correct order, reversed order, first-half-only, second-half-only, and a correct-order pair separated by a 90-second gap.

Bounded counts and track integrity. Clean two- and three-person counts, two people with deliberate occlusion, three people occluded so heavily that the correct behaviour is unresolved, a track-fragmentation decoy (one person leaving and returning in identical clothing), and a duplicate-track decoy (two people in identical outfits separating and rejoining).

Visible absence recorded as a matched pair. Four minutes of clearly assessable absence, the identical framing with a large occluder blocking part of the area, a positive control where the absence is broken, and a dark interval where neither judgement is safe.

Genuinely unobservable events across four distinct reasons: too dark to determine colour, placement hidden behind a pillar, backlit silhouette, and lighting good enough for the object but not the attribute.

Bounded disjunction (hat OR cap) covering all four truth combinations: first alternative true, second alternative true, neither true, both true simultaneously. Optionally repeated on a red/orange jacket pair.

The abandonment distinction. A short interruption where the owner stays in frame and returns, a true abandonment where the owner leaves frame entirely, and a deliberately borderline middle case labelled honestly as ambiguous.

A genuinely empty search interval. Ten uninterrupted minutes with normal incidental activity in which no black backpack, no hat or cap, and no object placement occurs anywhere in frame. Requires full human review of the entire declared scope before use as test truth.

organizer_pool_note: Organizer footage, if delivered, is recorded as sess_101+ under scenario ids scn_org_* in the organizer pool, split separately. It never shares a scenario_id with staged footage (SS21.5).
